details.summary: An outstanding, completely compliant dessert recipe that perfectly demonstrates how to satisfy a sweet tooth using whole foods. It requires no cooking, zero added sugar, and perfectly balances carbohydrates with healthy plant fats.

dimensions.feedback: The combination of dates, almond butter, cocoa, walnuts, and sea salt is a classic, highly coherent flavor profile. The bitterness of cocoa and walnuts beautifully balances the intense sweetness of the dates, enhanced by the sea salt.
All listed ingredients are used in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients appear. The prep state of the dates (pitted and halved) matches the assembly steps perfectly.
As a no-cook recipe, heat and timing instructions are not applicable. The assembly steps are clear, concise, and easy for a beginner to follow.
Stuffed dates are a traditional Mediterranean concept; filling them with almond butter and cocoa gives a recognizable, approachable American twist that fits the stated style well.
The no-cook, simple assembly method is perfectly suited for these ingredients.

The computed nutrition aligns perfectly with the ingredient quantities. The calories, carbohydrates, fiber, and protein are accurate for two large dates paired with a tablespoon of almond butter and a tablespoon of walnuts per person.
The title accurately reflects the recipe. The intro correctly highlights the whole-fruit sweetness, fiber, and protein, using an appropriate, encouraging tone without any disallowed health claims.
Highly appealing. It's an effortless, elegant, and satisfying dessert that feels decadent but remains entirely whole-food based.

An excellent example of eating for both conditions: the dates provide a whole, fiber-rich carbohydrate, while the unsaturated fats and plant protein from the almond butter and walnuts ensure a steady blood sugar response.

Perfectly balanced. Zero added sugar, with all sweetness coming from the dates. The 23.2g of carbohydrates per serving sits comfortably inside the dessert tier's 14-28g window, preventing both spikes and hypoglycemia.
Flawlessly fits the Dessert chapter. It hits the nutrient targets exactly, relies on fruit and nut butter as requested by the brief, and contains zero added sugar.
Easily completed in under 10 minutes from a cold start. All ingredients are mainstream staples readily available in any standard US supermarket.
